answer: The log2(TPM+1) expression distribution across all cell lines is MODERATELY POSITIVELY (right-)SKEWED: pooled Fisher–Pearson skewness g1 ≈ 0.69 (bias-corrected G1 identical to 6 decimals, 0.689708). The distribution has a long right tail — a large mass of low/zero-expression values (median 2.34, with ~25%+ of values near/below 0.08) and a small number of highly expressed genes stretching up to ~18.4. At the per-gene level the picture is consistent: median gene-wise skewness ≈ 0.41 (IQR −0.18 to 3.17), with ~65% of genes showing positive skew. Answer: the distribution is right-skewed (positive skew, moderate magnitude ≈ 0.7 pooled).
